SOURCES SOUGHT ANNOUNCEMENT
Water Treatment Service HVAC System FA4497-WTS-HVAC-SYSTEM

THIS IS A SOURCES SOUGHT ANNOUNCEMENT ONLY.
There is no solicitation available at this time. Requests for solicitation will not receive a response.

The 436th Contracting Squadron is seeking information concerning the availability of small business concern contractors capable of providing the following services:

Description of Services: The contractor shall furnish all labor, tools, transportation and supervision necessary to provide a service program to control corrosion, slime and algae in the condensers and service the thermal ice storage systems, closed loop heating and cooling systems, gas-fired heating hot water systems and water softeners at Dover AFB, DE.

Please see the attached Performance Work Statement (PWS) for a more in-depth overview of the required services. Please provide your current business size standard (e.g., Large or Small Business), any small business socioeconomic status (if applicable), and all applicable NAICS codes.

Please submit your responses to:
Contract Specialist: A1C Binod Pathak (binod.pathak.1@us.af.mil)
Contracting Officer: Justin Bordalo (justin.bordalo@us.af.mil)
